title: Import browser bookmarks
lead: Check the links first, then keep the original folders or file them into the ones you already have. GitHub Stars stays in Settings.
exportLead: Export an HTML file from your browser, then drop it below or click to choose it. Icons in the file are not uploaded.
exportChrome: Chrome: open chrome://bookmarks, click the ⋮ menu at the top right, then Export bookmarks.
exportEdge: Edge: open edge://favorites, click the … menu at the top right, then Export favorites.
exportFirefox: Firefox: menu → Bookmarks → Manage bookmarks, then Import and Backup → Export Bookmarks to HTML.
notHtml: Use the HTML file exported from your browser.
emptyFile: This file has no web bookmarks to import.
resume: An import is still in progress.
sampleMore: {{count}} in total. Only some are listed here.
placementOriginalHint: The bookmarks bar and other bookmarks stay as top-level folders. Anything past 5 levels is merged into the deepest one.
placementExistingHint: Only folders you already have. Nothing new is created.
placementAiHint: Folders are suggested from the title and address, and created only after you confirm.
aiUnavailable: DeepSeek is not configured. Sorting is unavailable. You can still keep the original folders.
deadImport: Import them and mark as unavailable
publicWarning: Public browsing is on. After you confirm, visitors will be able to see these links.

errors.IMPORT_ACTIVE: Another import is still in progress.
errors.AI_UNAVAILABLE: DeepSeek is not configured. You can only keep the original folders.
errors.HAS_FOLDERS: Folders already exist, so this import cannot create a new set.
errors.IMPORT_CLOSED: This import has moved on. Refresh and check again.
errors.TOO_MANY: One import can take at most 20,000 bookmarks.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Some bookmarks were not valid. Try another file.
